if doc.status == "Opportunity":
    try:
        # 🔹 Check if Contact already exists
        contact = frappe.db.exists("Contact", {"first_name": doc.lead_name})
        
        if not contact:
            contact_doc = frappe.get_doc({
                "doctype": "Contact",
                "first_name": doc.lead_name or doc.company_name,
                "phone": doc.mobile_no,
                "email_ids": [
                    {
                        "email_id": doc.email_id,
                        "is_primary": 1
                    }
                ]
            })
            contact_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            contact = contact_doc.name

        # 🔹 Create Opportunity with Contact linked
        opportunity = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "Opportunity",
            "opportunity_from": "Lead",
            "party_name": doc.name,
            "customer_name": doc.lead_name or doc.company_name,
            "contact_person": contact,
            "contact_email": doc.email_id,
            "contact_mobile": doc.mobile_no,
            "territory": doc.territory or "All Territories",
            "source": doc.source,
            "opportunity_owner": doc.lead_owner,
            "company": doc.company or frappe.defaults.get_user_default("Company")
        })

        # ✅ Important: Insert Opportunity
        opportunity.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

        frappe.msgprint(f"Opportunity {opportunity.name} created successfully with Contact {contact}!")

    except Exception as e:
        frappe.log_error(f"Error creating opportunity from lead {doc.name}: {str(e)}")
        frappe.throw(f"Failed to create opportunity: {str(e)}")
